_readme: EVERY entry needs a non-empty 'justification'. The tool refuses to load the
file otherwise. There is deliberately no --baseline / auto-generate mode:
machine-generated suppression is how this defect class accumulated in the
first place. Each line below is a human claim that someone checked the site.
Entries are keyed by file + rule + symbol, NOT by line number, so edits above
a site do not silently un-suppress or re-suppress it.
The bar for an entry: the sentinel is the function's DECLARED CONTRACT, it
fails in the SAFE direction, and the call sites were read and do check it.
'It has always been like that' is not a justification.
Added 2026-08-14 under WP-00-DETECTOR. Every entry below was verified by
reading the function and its call sites at 16ea217; see the WP-00-DETECTOR

allow.justification: Declared contract: signature is -> Optional[dict] and the docstring states 'None on any error'. Returning None DENIES authentication, so it fails closed. All 9 call sites assign the result and branch on it (auth.py:56, ws_logs.py:43, rate_limit.py:56, audit.py:159, auth_service.py:86/113/122/147/186). Verified at 16ea217.

Fails closed and the failure is already surfaced: the handler calls websocket.close(code=1008, reason='Authentication error') before returning False, so the client is disconnected. The bool is the caller's signal, not a swallowed error. Verified at 16ea217.

Inverted polarity: False means 'truncated / not ok'. Returning False on an unreadable file is the SAFE direction - it reports corruption rather than concealing it. Caller checks it (corruption_detector.py:267, 'truncation_ok = self._check_truncation(...)'). Verified at 16ea217.
Health predicate. Its entire purpose is to answer 'is the database reachable' as a bool; False on exception IS the correct answer and fails closed. Verified at 16ea217.

Health predicate, same reasoning as check_db_connection. False on exception means 'not reachable', which is true. NOTE: only ping() is allowlisted in this file - the other eight RedisClient methods ARE flagged instances and are recorded in the WP-00 register. Verified at 16ea217.
